messages:
Priya Sharma: Hey team — draft of the product launch blog is up. link: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-draft-v3 (please skim). Main asks: 1) claim language check, 2) benchmark numbers confirmation, 3) publishing window + demo seat mapping. Can folks take a quick pass today? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Elaine Wu: reading now. where are the benchmark charts? I only see summary numbers in the hero section.
Priya Sharma: @Elaine Wu charts are in the Google slide linked at the top (tab 2). I pulled P50/P95 latency and tokens/sec for the HS benchmark. need verification vs infra team numbers.
AJ: quick note — hero claim "up to 60% lower per-token cost" needs the qualifier "on average across text-generation workloads" or legal will flag.
Sam Patel: looping infra: @infra please confirm the test rig: a40 x2, sequence 1024, mixed-batch. if it's different we need to update the doc numbers.
Maria Gomez: small copy tweak suggestion for the CTA — change "Try Redwood" to "Try Redwood with your prompts" (better conversion). also recommend adding webinar CTA below the primary CTA.
Priya Sharma: good rec @Maria Gomez. webinar CTA will go to the demo sign-up. Can we lock the webinar date? Thinking Wed 4/14 afternoon PT.
Elaine Wu: regarding benchmarks — I ran a quick diff vs the shared sheet, numbers match except P95 on long-context model is +8%. I annotated the slide with a note.
legal-bot: Automated check: hero claims referencing specific percentage reductions require source link and internal sign-off. See /legal/claims-guidelines.
AJ: tagging @legal-bot for next steps. Sam — can infra produce the full run log for the long-context run? we'll need it for legal and docs.
Sam Patel: yes, I'll export logs by EOD and attach here.
Maria Gomez: draft has one paragraph that's a bit jargon-heavy (section 'Compilation & Kernel Selection'). Suggest simplifying to 2 short bullets and linking deeper doc for readers who want tech details.
Priya Sharma: agree — keeping launch post approachable is priority. I'll pare down that section to 2 bullets and link the deep dive.
marketing-bot: Publish checklist reminder: publish-preflight (assets locked) -> legal signoff -> marketing approvals -> scheduled publish time. Current status: assets draft, legal pending, approvals partial.
Elaine Wu: legal will take ~24-48h once logs + claim sources are provided. if we want 4/14 webinar, publish should be by 4/7 latest.
AJ: OK — action items: Sam to attach logs, Priya to revise copy + swap hero qualifier, Maria to add webinar CTA + registration link, myself to follow-up with legal after logs posted.
Priya Sharma: I'll update the doc now and ping when ready. Thanks all :raised_hands:
Sam Patel: uploading logs now, will post link in thread when done.
Priya Sharma: posted revised draft (v3.1) and inline comments addressed. Please give a thumbs if good. :thumbsup:
Elaine Wu: thumbs from me. :white_check_mark:
AJ: :eyes: will do legal follow-up once logs link is up.
marketing-bot: New artifact uploaded: draft-v3.1.html (public preview).
Priya Sharma: final ask — if anyone is blocking approval past EOD tomorrow, call it out here. otherwise I'll queue for legal once Sam's logs are in.
Maria Gomez: no blockers from my side. go ahead. :rocket:
Sam Patel: logs attached: https://s3.redwood.ai/infra-logs/1766664444-longcontext.json
Priya Sharma: thanks Sam — tagging @AJ and @legal-bot for signoff. will schedule internal dry-run for demo 4/12.
AJ: got it, starting legal run.
Priya Sharma: end of thread — will update publish checklist once signoffs complete.
